status: adopted; both current online sources AC and matched

environment.metric: std::clock per process CPU time. Copy executable into fixed path/inode before run, outside timing. Same baseline control, fixed random seed for order. 5-rep exploratory; 7-rep final and opaque followup. Ratios of medians.
environment.limit: CPU pinning is not system-wide exclusion. Identical-code control timings distinguish noise; no universal fastest claim.

adopted: reset: resize initializes new suffix, fill only min(old_size,count) retained elements; parent/weight reservations and T(0) before logical mutation; nothrow type conditions/fallback unchanged
groups non-Clang: exact negative root sizes reserve output, one slot scratch array instead of roots+counts
groups Clang x86 default, n>=256 and runtime AVX2: shared CC0 GatherGroupRoots<false> helper, unresolved lanes only, overwrite roots storage, root negative sizes for output; two scratch arrays
Clang __AVX2__ builds retain standard path; SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD removes added intrinsic header/helper/CPU selection. Same shared helper guard and body as unweighted RollbackUF.

proofs.reset: New suffix receives -1/T(0) from resize; retained prefix is filled. Copy/assign/destruct nothrow conditions and fallback remain. Independent type default=999 confirms explicit zero.
proofs.groups: Every negative root value equals component size after unite/undo/rollback; output vectors are created in root order, vertices appended in increasing order; parents/weights/history never modified.
proofs.SIMD: Indices/lane roots stay in 0..n-1; inactive root lanes never gather; all output entries written, including scalar tail; helper body byte-identical to shared existing helper.
proofs.unchanged_API: Two frozen Verify mains in 5 configurations (10 pairs) and arithmetic/query/merge-only API program Mint/int64/Ring/cpp_int plus forced-standard int64 in GCC+Clang (10 pairs) have identical .text. No fields/history layout or arithmetic changes.

rejected_or_limited.Clang_native_manual_SIMD: Balanced component size16 at 131072 vertices was 1.041x (control1.010) in screening; native target already auto-vectorizes standard code. Final excludes manual header/helper/CPU check under __AVX2__, groups benchmark .text is identical there.
rejected_or_limited.small: Final closed-loop 32 vertex GCC15.2 native Mint same-size reset 5.48ns ->8.06ns (+2.58ns, 1.470x), groups small maximum1.070x; large improvements prioritized. Opaque followup reported separately (common call cost included).
rejected_or_limited.other_proposals: Static same-parent unite-only and slow-query prefix passing discussed, not adopted or claimed measured.

reset_modes.4: fresh empty object reset then destruction

opaque_followup: Reset benchmark passes object address after every reset to a separately compiled external benchmark_escape function (volatile pointer store). Without LTO, optimizer must treat object and reachable state as observable. Same extra call in baseline/control/final; its cost is not subtracted. Preparation, pilot, post-timing state check excluded. This is supplementary benchmark code, not Verify main.

escape.cpp.content: extern "C" { const void* volatile benchmark_observed; void benchmark_escape(const void* object) { benchmark_observed = object; } }

from pathlib import Path
import json,tomllib,subprocess,hashlib,shutil
p=Path(__file__).parent;up=next((p/'upstream').iterdir());problem=up/'data_structure/unionfind_with_potential';params=tomllib.loads((problem/'info.toml').read_text())['params'];(problem/'params.h').write_text(''.join(f'#define {k} {v}\n' for k,v in params.items()))
out=p/'official_potential';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);builds=[]
for name in ['random','max_random','path','correct']:
 src=problem/('sol/correct.cpp' if name=='correct' else 'gen/'+name+'.cpp');exe=out/name;cmd=['taskset','-c','4','/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-I'+str(up/'common'),str(src),'-o',str(exe)];a=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert a.returncode==0,a.stderr;builds.append(dict(command=cmd,source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
hashes=json.loads((problem/'hash.json').read_text());rows=[]
for name,number in [('example',1),('random',10),('max_random',3),('path',4)]:
 for i in range(number):
  src=out/f'{name}_{i:02}.in';dst=src.with_suffix('.out')
  if name=='example':shutil.copyfile(problem/'gen/example_00.in',src)
  else:
   with src.open('wb')as f:subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','4',str(out/name),str(i)],stdout=f,check=True)
  assert hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hashes[src.name],src
  with src.open('rb')as f,dst.open('wb')as g:subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','4',str(out/'correct')],stdin=f,stdout=g,check=True)
  assert hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hashes[dst.name],dst
  rows.append(dict(input=src.name,input_sha256=hashes[src.name],output_sha256=hashes[dst.name],hash_matches_upstream=True))
(p/'official-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(upstream_commit='73876f1cbcf082d2b22722924b924d3d65a2f00e',cases=rows,builds=builds),indent=2));print('official input/output hashes verified:',len(rows))
